# Iteration 1 Design Assets

User direction: use the formal Chinese name “上海创智学院”; keep poster content simple to reduce hallucinated text and visual clutter.

## Regenerated Files

1. `sii-shanghai-bilingual-lockup.png`
   - Replaces: `../sii-bilingual-lockup.png`
   - Size: 1536x1024
   - Changes: uses exact Chinese name “上海创智学院”; keeps English “Shanghai Innovation Institute”; removes extra copy and limits the composition to a clean institutional lockup.
   - Image text QA: no visible text errors or hallucinated extra text detected by image analysis.

2. `sii-simple-doctoral-selection-poster.png`
   - Replaces: `../sii-doctoral-selection-camp-poster.png`
   - Size: 1024x1536
   - Changes: simplified poster with only “上海创智学院”, “博士遴选营”, “Calling for Marvellers”, and “SII.CAMP.2026”; avoids fake dates, QR codes, charts, dense paragraphs, and extra labels.
   - Image text QA: no visible text errors or hallucinated extra text detected by image analysis.

3. `sii-text-safe-guideline-board.png`
   - Replaces: `../sii-research-os-system-board.png`
   - Size: 1536x1024
   - Changes: uses primary Chinese name “上海创智学院”; reduces the board to four large sections; removes dense microcopy and hallucination-prone small labels.
   - Image text QA: no visible text errors, no hallucinated tiny text, and simpler layout confirmed by image analysis.
